thread:
PagerBot: P1 triggered: high tail latency on inference-api (service=requests.frontend) — paging on-call (rule: infer_api_high_p99 > 1200ms) :rotating_light:
Anya: on it. seeing a big p99 spike in eu-west-1. Repro?
Karl: I can help — pulling logs and looking at autoscaler metrics now.
Jess: FYI product reports a few users saw errors when requests exceeded ~10k tokens. Possible batch timeout?
Anya: Confirmed increased queuing. 99th latency ~1.4s, 95th ~450ms. Throughput steady.
Karl: Autoscaler didn't add pods fast enough. Looks like node GPU utilization hit 98% and new instances are taking too long to spin.
Marc: Any customer impact? Which customers hit errors?
Anya: Quick scan: 3 paid tenants had retried calls; ~30 total failed requests in the 30m window. Not widespread but definitely customer-visible.
PagerBot: Incident created INC-2026-0423, channel #incidents. Severity=P1.
Anya: Mitigation plan: 1) scale up dedicated pool manually 2) enable fallback route to smaller-quantized model for non-SLA tenants 3) adjust alert to avoid immediate flapping.
Karl: Running scale command: `rctl infra scale --pool inference-eu-west --count +4`
Jess: Also toggling batch timeout from 30s -> 45s to avoid mid-request timeouts while we scale.
Karl: Scale job submitted, cloud init in progress. ETA ~3m.
Anya: Routing rule: will flip traffic for tier=non-sla to model=redwood-small-8q on the router so high-latency requests can continue. Doing a quick canary (5%).
Marc: Good. Can you add a note to the incident about which tenants were routed? I want to follow up with CS after.
Anya: Added: routed tenants = [acme-corp, shopbox, datawave] — lowered fidelity for those three.
PagerBot: Auto-alert: New instances registered at 1762345750.
Karl: Instances up. p99 dropping to ~600ms. Canary routing holding.
Jess: Errors cleared from the monitored customers. No further 5xx reported in logs.
Anya: Handing off to night on-call in 25m. Will post a quick mitigation summary and open follow-ups for tuning.
HandoffBot: Handoff reminder scheduled at 1762345840.
Marc: Post-incident asks: can we reduce alert noise? The current rule fired hard even as it was a short-lived scale jitter. We need smarter thresholds or a secondary suppression.
Karl: Agreed. My quick thought: add a sliding-window requirement (p99 > 1200ms for 3/5 consecutive 1m buckets) and suppress on scale events.
Jess: Also consider splitting alerts by error type and customer tier — P1 only if sla customers impacted. Lower severity for non-sla.
Anya: I'll create action items: 1) tune alert rule 2) create an incident-retro dashboard with drilldowns to correlate autoscaler, GPU util, and router decisions 3) add an evaluation run for batch timeout regressions.
Karl: For the dashboard, propose panels: golden signals (p50/p95/p99 request latency, errors, throughput), GPU utilization heatmap, autoscaler event timeline, routing fallback events, and raw request trace sampling.
Jess: We should add a panel for "requests hitting fallback model" over time — easy to query and shows routing effectiveness.
Marc: Add a panel that lists impacted tenants and counts (time window). Useful for CS handoff.
Anya: Draft PromQL snippets for the panels: 
```
# p99 latency
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, handler))
# GPU util per node
avg(node_gpu_utilization) by (instance)
# fallback route count
sum(infer_router_requests_total{route="fallback-small"})
```
Karl: I'll spin up a quick Grafana board skeleton in the infra Grafana folder: dash id -> infer-incident-retro-1762345678. Will add drilldown links to traces and the autoscaler timeline.
Jess: Suggest panel layout: top row golden signals, middle row infra (gpu, nodes, autoscaler), bottom row routing & customers; with drilldowns to service dashboard and logs.
Anya: Also: alert tuning specifics — propose new rule: `infer_api_p99_sustained_high` where p99 > 1200ms sustained for 3/5m AND impacted_sla_tenants > 0. Suppress if `autoscaler_event_recent==true` within 2m.
Karl: We can implement suppression via Alertmanager with a silence template triggered by scale events. I'll prototype.
Marc: Who owns the dashboard build and alert PR?
Anya: I'll own the dashboard and the initial alert PR. Karl will prototype the alertmanager suppression. Jess will add evaluation tests.
Anya: I'll post a short incident summary for customers and loop in CS to notify the three tenants.
HandoffBot: Handoff to night: Anya -> Karl at 1762345900.
Karl: Taking over. Left notes in the incident doc. I'll follow up tomorrow with the PRs for alert changes and the Grafana JSON.
Marc: Thanks everyone. Please add any follow-ups to the incident board INC-2026-0423/followups.
PagerBot: Incident status changed to MONITORING at 1762345885.
Anya: Closing active mitigation. Will do a short retro and link the new dashboard once it's ready. :white_check_mark:
